note: This increment adds HTTP unsupported-encoding and gzip-expansion boundaries. The minidump handler and protocol transport are unchanged from the 007 receipt.
covered: Crashpad's sentry_client/sentry_key query without sentry_version is accepted only on the minidump route
an explicitly supplied version must be 7; version 8, missing keys, disagreeing keys and malformed queries are rejected
the full multipart body is gzip-decoded before multipart parsing
supported identity, gzip, deflate, br and zstd encodings decode; unsupported encodings return 415
compressed and expanded bodies have independent MAX_BODY_BYTES limits and overflow returns 413
truncated compressed streams fail before persistence
failed encoding or expansion requests create no event
other SDK ingestion retains the existing version-7 authentication
limits: No real sentry-native binary was run in this increment; the 026 demo covers that workflow.
No final image or public CI was exercised.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
